diagnosis: Resizes and serves image media assets on the fly based on the asset_id query parameter. It fails to verify if private media assets belong to the requesting user.

corrected_code:
@router.get('/api/media/thumbnail')
async def get_media_thumbnail(
    asset_id: int = Query(...),
    width: int = Query(128),
    height: int = Query(128),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    result = await db.execute(select(MediaAsset).where(MediaAsset.id == asset_id, MediaAsset.user_id == user.id))
    asset = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not asset or not os.path.exists(asset.disk_path):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Asset not found")
        
    img = Image.open(asset.disk_path)
    img.thumbnail((width, height))
    out_io = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(out_io, format="JPEG")
    out_io.seek(0)
    return StreamingResponse(out_io, media_type="image/jpeg")
